item.title: ICE to Equip Officers with Electric Shock Gloves
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement may soon provide agents with gloves capable of delivering electric shocks to subdue individuals.

item.title: Nick Reiner indicted on charges of murdering parents Rob and Michele Reiner
item.description: Prosecutors allege he killed his parents, director Rob Reiner and his wife, by lying in wait, according to the indictment.

item.title: WATCH: Dancing for a gas discount
item.description: A Sunoco station in Halfmoon, New York, offers a 20% discount to customers who show off their dance moves.
